annotations.scope: Three shared pure conversions used by the Gift glob renderer. No claim that this implements every foundation:text operation.
annotations.sourceRelation: ripgrep P 4c2362d359d9913c7a5e391ccd79cb4da22bc89b crates/globset/src/glob.rs:768-789 uses char::encode_utf8, ASCII character conversion and lowercase two-digit hexadecimal formatting. This module gives those primitive value conversions as Gift bodies, not native ripgrep callbacks.
annotations.domains: ScalarUtf8 accepts exactly 0..0x10ffff excluding 0xd800..0xdfff. AsciiText accepts 0..127. ByteHexLower accepts 0..255. All public invalid inputs return their original Int in the corresponding ConversionError before conversion.
annotations.arithmetic: Only mathematical Int; IntDivMod divisors at real call sites are 16 or 64. ArithmeticInvariant is the explicit defensive branch for a reported arithmetic failure, not panic or empty success.
annotations.asciiTable: AsciiLookup has exactly 128 literal leaves for U+0000 through U+007F and a balanced selection tree; HexNibble has exactly 16 leaves 0..9,a..f. These are the intrinsic finite encodings, not application-input examples.
annotations.unimplementedExports: TrimEndUnicodeWhitespace requested by command remains OPEN and is not exported by this slice.
annotations.qualification: Pure-body local validation is not a production Reader/linker/Target or entire-ripgrep equivalence result. Standard Ordering/Result/Sequence and exact Text scalar/normalization profiles still require actual qualified engine bindings.
